name: Creamy Celeriac and Ham Hock Soup
subtitle: A silky root-vegetable soup finished with mustard and tender ham.
description: Simmer the ham hock until tender, then blend celeriac and apple into a creamy soup with mustard. Finish with shredded ham, crème fraîche, and a drizzle of oil.

ingredients.item: unsmoked ham hock or gammon knuckle
olive or rapeseed oil plus extra to serve
celeriac washed and cut into chunks (or peeled if very dirty)
crème fraîche plus extra to serve

instructions.text: Place the ham hock and bay leaves in a large pot, cover with water, and bring to a simmer. Cook for 120 minutes, until the meat is very tender and reaches at least 145°F; rest it for 3 minutes before handling.
Remove the ham hock and bay leaves. Reserve the cooking liquid, discard the bay leaves, and pull the meat from the bone once cool enough to handle.
Heat the oil in the pot. Add the onion, apple, and celeriac, and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add enough reserved cooking liquid to cover the vegetables. Simmer for 20 minutes, until the celeriac is tender.
Blend the soup until smooth, then stir in the crème fraîche and mustard. Adjust the consistency with more reserved cooking liquid if needed.
Return the shredded ham to the soup and warm through. Serve with extra crème fraîche, oil, and crusty bread.
